messages:
incident-bot: :warning: ALERT: gpunode-17 reports repeated container restarts for runtime-service v2.3.4 — memory spike during prefill. Pager triggered. Trace: /alerts/3370001112

caroline (sre-oncall): grabbing it. initial telemetry shows sustained prefill mem > 95% and a CUDA error before the restart.

dan (ml-runtime): can you paste the container stdout? guessing a long single prompt pushed kv cache and prefill allocation.

eva (infra): node gpunode-17 is in cluster gpu-prod-e; isolating to prevent noisy neighbor. starting cordon.

caroline (sre-oncall): cordon done. scaling down new placements to avoid moving pods onto this node.

frank (support): customer @acme-ml reported timeouts ~10:02 UTC, says chat completions failed and saw 502s. I left them a note that we are investigating.

alice (eng-lead): @dan if this is prefill long-context, any quick mitigation we can flip? lower prefill max_tokens or trim?

dan (ml-runtime): rolling a hot-config: runtime flag --prefill-max-tokens=8192 -> 4096 for now and enable aggressive kv-eviction for long contexts. Pushing a config patch to the fleet.

sre-alert-bot: Deploy config patch queued: cfg-2026-03-17-09. Rolling to 20% of instances in gpu-prod-e.

caroline (sre-oncall): noticed one container had this stack before it died:
```
E cuda: out of memory (cuMemAlloc) at runtime/src/allocator.c:243
E runtime: prefill: alloc 6.8GiB fail, kv_cache 12.1GiB in use
W runtime: triggering graceful shutdown, restarting container
```

dan (ml-runtime): that matches a single-request ~1.2M token history with many system messages. We didn't have tenant-level max_tokens enforcement for chat-streaming in this model variant.

eva (infra): isolating node to debug hardware? No driver resets yet, but will run nvidia-smi and collect dmesg.

caroline (sre-oncall): customer impact: ~3% of requests in the region returned 5xx over 09:01-09:12 UTC, transient. @irene please prepare the customer note.

irene (cs): on it. Drafting: "We saw transient inference errors caused by extremely long prompts that triggered GPU OOM and restarts. Mitigation applied: temporary token cap + eviction. We will follow up with root cause and long-term fix."

frank (support): customer escalation: ACME says this was during a marketing surge with long transcripts. They're okay with a temporary cap but want ETA.

alice (eng-lead): ETA for wider roll? @dan how long to push to 100%?

dan (ml-runtime): can push to 100% in ~8 minutes after monitoring first 20% for errors. Doing a canary now.

sre-alert-bot: Canary deployment success at 20% (3/3 health checks). Proceeding.

caroline (sre-oncall): while roll completes, I've added a per-tenant emergency throttle for unusually large prefill requests (>= 500k tokens) to avoid repeats. Applied to ACME tenant.

dan (ml-runtime): logs show 2 distinct error variants: OOM on cuMemAlloc and one CUDA driver timeout when kernel launch stalled. Both followed by restart. Likely memory fragmentation + single big allocation. Will add allocation tracing.

eva (infra): nvidia-smi dump attached: GPU0 memory fragmentation high, no hardware ECC errors. Collecting kube events and container /var/log/containers.

irene (cs): sent message to ACME: "We've applied a temporary cap and are monitoring. We'll send a postmortem with timeline and mitigations." They acknowledged.

caroline (sre-oncall): action items for post-incident:
- dan: make long-request soft-failures and enforce token quota on model variant
- eva: schedule node gpunode-17 deep diagnostics and repro attempt
- alice: consider model-variant config that sets KV eviction thresholds per-sequence
- support/CS: customer comms + incident summary

dan (ml-runtime): logging ticket filed: INF-7832 with allocation traces and a test harness to reproduce 1.2M token prefill.

caroline (sre-oncall): last check: error rate back to baseline, container restarts stopped after config patch. Marking this thread for postmortem write-up.

frank (support): closing loop with ACME, they requested opt-out for the cap for a single legacy job; we advised scheduling a safe test.

alice (eng-lead): good coordination. We'll sync on postmortem tomorrow. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident resolved (partial mitigation deployed). See follow-up: /incidents/3370001112/postmortem
